extraction.name: EuroSAT
extraction.description: A novel dataset based on Sentinel-2 satellite images covering 13 spectral bands and consisting of 10 classes with in total 27,000 labeled and geo-referenced images for land use and land cover classification. The dataset covers classes including annual crop, permanent crop, pasture, highway, residential buildings, industrial buildings, river, sea & lake, forest, and herbaceous vegetation. Both RGB and multi-spectral versions are released.
extraction.creator: Patrick Helber, Benjamin Bischke, Andreas Dengel, Damian Borth
extraction.publisher: German Research Center for Artificial Intelligence (DFKI) / TU Kaiserslautern
extraction.citeAs: Patrick Helber, Benjamin Bischke, Andreas Dengel, Damian Borth. EuroSAT: A Novel Dataset and Deep Learning Benchmark for Land Use and Land Cover Classification. arXiv:1709.00029v2 [cs.CV], 1 Feb 2019.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Satellite images were downloaded from the Sentinel-2A satellite via Amazon S3. Images were selected from European cities distributed in over 34 countries covered by the European Urban Atlas. Images with low cloud levels were selected. Images were recorded throughout the year to capture high variance in land use and land cover classes. From the obtained satellite images, 27,000 georeferenced and labeled image patches of 64x64 pixels were created and manually checked multiple times.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Physical data collection, Secondary Data analysis
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Multi-spectral satellite images acquired by the Sentinel-2A satellite, downloaded via Amazon S3. Images are associated with cities covered in the European Urban Atlas, distributed over 34 European countries.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Bands with a lower spatial resolution were upsampled to 10 meters per pixel using cubic-spline interpolation. For comparative evaluation, RGB color space images were computed by combining the red (B04), green (B03) and blue (B02) bands.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Satellite images with low cloud coverage were selected. Image patches of 64x64 pixels were extracted. All 27,000 images were manually checked multiple times and mislabeled images as well as images full of snow or ice were removed. The dataset has not received atmospheric correction. Classes were chosen based on the principle that they are visible at 10 meters per pixel resolution and are frequently enough covered by the European Urban Atlas to generate thousands of image patches.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Image patches were labeled according to 10 land use and land cover classes based on the European Urban Atlas mapping guide. All 27,000 images were manually checked multiple times and mislabeled images were corrected or removed.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: All 27,000 images were manually checked multiple times. Mislabeled images as well as images full of snow or ice were sorted out. Images with color cast due to atmospheric effects were retained intentionally to allow the classifier to learn these cases.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset enables real-world Earth observation applications including land use and land cover change detection (e.g., detecting deforestation, urban development, demolition of buildings), and assistance in keeping geographical maps up-to-date (e.g., OpenStreetMap). Applications span agriculture, disaster recovery, climate change monitoring, urban development, and environmental monitoring. Deforestation detection is highlighted as particularly relevant for climate change and illegal forest clearing.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The distribution of georeferenced images is influenced by the number of represented cities per country in the European Urban Atlas. The dataset has not received atmospheric correction, which can result in images with a color cast. Images were selected with low cloud coverage, which may introduce a seasonal or geographic bias.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset has not received atmospheric correction, resulting in some images with color cast. The patch-based classification system (64x64 pixels) does not allow finely graduated per-pixel segmentation. The spatial resolution is 10 meters per pixel, which limits the distinguishability of fine-grained classes. The dataset is limited to European cities covered by the European Urban Atlas.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training, Testing, and Validation for land use and land cover classification using deep Convolutional Neural Networks. The dataset can be used as a benchmark for satellite image classification, for land use and land cover change detection, and for assisting in improving and updating geographical maps. It is intended to make large amounts of Sentinel-2 satellite imagery accessible for machine learning approaches.
